headline: Reducing tax obligations helps businesses recover and expand production
summary: Vietnamese authorities are pursuing tax and customs policies, extended financial obligations and simpler procedures to help businesses expand production. The aim is to sustain double-digit growth.
why: Tax and cost policies shape corporate earnings and investment decisions, and sustained growth targets signal the direction of economic policy.
